name: Overbearing Onslaught
body:
Overbearing Onslaught (Ex)
Source Advanced Player's Guide pg. 76
While raging, the barbarian may overrun more than one target per round, with a –2 penalty on her CMB for each overrun check after the first. A barbarian must have the overbearing advance rage power to select this rage power. A barbarian must be at least 6th level to select this rage power.
